name: Tokunaga Satsuki
source:
She was in the same class and club as Yuuto.
While she didn't particularly stand out in club activities, she excelled at her studies.
She harbored feelings for Koudai, who was always friendly and approachable.
Earnest and gentle, yet surprisingly stern with those close to her.

[Translated from [url=https://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc094/index.html]official website[/url]]
